home.heroSubtitle: 48-hour fermented dough, traditional wood-fired oven, carefully selected ingredients. The authentic taste of Italy, right in the heart of Annaba.
home.aboutText: At Zaguette family, pizza is a family affair. We work with traditional Italian recipes: long-fermented dough, a wood-fired oven that reaches 400°C, hand-picked mozzarella and tomatoes. A thin crust, lightly charred by the embers, and generous toppings — that's the Zaguette spirit.
